summary: This Form 6-K reports the publication of NuCana plc's 2025 UK Annual Report and the distribution of a notice for its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 8, 2026. The filing also describes the mailing of voting materials by Citibank as depositary for the company's American Depositary Shares to enable ADS holders to instruct voting on the underlying ordinary shares. The AGM agenda includes routine items such as re-election of directors, reappointment of auditors, and approval of remuneration reports. There are no special-situation events; this is a standard periodic filing, mapping to a routine current report for a foreign private issuer.
